dialect.jaymoskingdoms.olden.speech.jaym: Town fool, come hence, if thou value thy life! For %s, my sword is thine.
Either thou art in want of a knight, or thou art the town fool. %s, and I ride with thee.
Alas, mine oath is not so cheap. %s, no less.
Have at thee, then! Lead on.
I swear it upon mine honour: whither thou goest, I go.
A hot meal and a worthy fight. 'Tis more than fair.
